Class ItemReportController

java.lang.Object
edu.tamu.csce331.squad23.controller.ItemReportController
public class ItemReportController extends Object
Controller for the manager's sales by item report (item-report-view.fxml). Shows how many of each menu item were sold and the revenue from each in a date range, as a table with a total row, a bar chart of quantities, or a bar chart of revenue.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Called by JavaFX after the FXML is loaded. Fills the view choices and shows only the chosen view, starting with the table. Sets up the two chart series and the table columns (Item, Quantity Sold, and Revenue as a dollar amount), defaults the date range to the last 7 days, and connects the Run button. The report doesn't run until Run is clicked.

    • runReport

      private void runReport()
      Runs the report for the chosen date range in the background. The table and charts are dimmed while it runs. On success the table and both charts are refilled and a TOTAL row is added to the bottom of the table (not the charts). The status label reports the number of items sold, that there were no sales, or the error. The table and charts stay dimmed if there were no sales or the report failed.
